messages:
Ravi (incidents): quick sync on follow-ups from last night's outage. Need: statuspage line, 72h customer summary owner, and a short RCA sharing playbook (consent + redaction). who takes what?
incident-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-03-23-cache-rollout (unassigned)
Ethan Ops: I can take statuspage + 72h placeholder. Draft snippet: 'Partial service degradation for service Y between 02:10-02:35 UTC due to cache priming during rollout. Mitigation: rollback + throttling. 72h summary will be posted; full RCA available on request subject to redaction/consent.'
Maya Support: Support will own customer outreach and Intercom copy. Please include a one-line 'what we did to protect customers' and an FAQ on how to request the full RCA.
Lina Legal: Policy: public summary = redacted. Full technical RCA = available on request under consent. I'll provide a redaction checklist and consent blurb. No PII or tokens in shared docs.
Drew Product: Noting recurring pattern (rollout triggers cache storms). I'll add a rollout-guard item to the postmortem checklist and suggest conservative canary rates.
Ravi (incidents): Action items: - ethan_ops: publish statuspage + 72h placeholder (due 2185001360) - maya_support: Intercom template + proactive customer list (due 2185001420) - lina_legal: redaction checklist + consent blurb (due 2185001460) - drew_product: update checklist + canary suggestion (due 2185001540). Reply with :+1: to claim.
Ethan Ops: :+1: publishing now, will ping when live.
Maya Support: :+1: drafting Intercom copy, will DM high-touch list.
Lina Legal: :+1: redaction checklist and consent blurb incoming.
Drew Product: :+1: updating checklist and attaching guard values.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up review in 72h to confirm comms + consent docs.
Ravi (incidents): thanks all  we'll verify at the review and then close actions.
